# Arc UI Notification Center

Source: https://uiarc.dev/components/blocks/notification-center
Registry: https://uiarc.dev/r/notification-center.json
License: https://uiarc.dev/license
Retrieved: 2026-10-18. Free block, MIT license.

Used in `frontend/components/dashboard/attention-inbox.tsx` and its CSS module.
The panel styling and interaction patterns are adapted from the free Notification Center.
CodeForge uses its existing Base UI popover, Motion, semantic colors and real run data.
Read/dismiss state remains local to each user. Approval requests cannot be cleared.
No Arc service, paid component, global foundation or additional dependency is used.
